name: ainwork-code-search
title: AIINWORK Code Search MCP
description: Local stdio MCP server for searching a selected code root and optionally proxying GitNexus semantic analysis.
author: AIINWORK

setupFields.label: root
setupFields.description: Default code root used when MCP tools are called without a root argument.

setupFields.label: Allowed roots
setupFields.description: Optional allowlist. On Windows, separate multiple roots with semicolons.

setupFields.label: GitNexus command
setupFields.description: Optional local GitNexus executable. Leave empty to use npm exec with the pinned GitNexus package.

runtimeFields.label: root
runtimeFields.description: Optional per-call override for the configured default root.

tools.name: list_code_roots
tools.description: Show configured default and allowed roots.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a bounded file slice with line numbers.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Check runtime dependencies and GitNexus readiness.
